ICSSR Research Internship 2027

Full-time research internship at the Indian Council of Social Science Research, New Delhi — 3 months for junior and 6 months for senior interns.

STIPEND / MONTH
₹20,000
Stipend details
Junior interns ₹20,000/month; senior interns ₹25,000/month (fixed).
Expected application window
To be confirmed
Format & location
In person · New Delhi
Who can apply
Junior: currently pursuing a master's in social sciences. Senior: master's in social sciences with 55%+.
Accommodation & support
No accommodation provided; interns arrange their own (ICSSR has no residential facility)

Entry notes

  • The 2026 call closed in July–August 2026; watch icssr.org → Opportunities → Internships for the next notification.
  • Applications were by email or post, as set out in the notification.
